title: TrashCans issue #63: [Crash] Stoneblock 4 Single Player World "disconnects" on putting item in Trash can
licence: GitHub issue thread: user-generated content under the GitHub Terms of Service; the repo licence (none) does not cover issue text
text:
[issue by dBHI-zz]
### Minecraft version

1.21.1

### Mod Loader

Forge

### Trash Cans version

1.1.1

### Game environment

Client

### Steps to reproduce

Shift click an Iron Hammer (Just Hammers) into the Trash Can

I am playing Stoneblock4 and it crashed my world (not the game) when entering a few items  into the trash can manually by shift clicking. I tried to update Trash Can and the Lib Mod to the latest version, but it did not fix the issue. I repeated the process about 10 times and most of the times the internal server crashed, or disconnected with 

[net.minecraft.client.multiplayer.ClientCommonPacketListenerImpl/]: Client disconnected with reason: Internal Exception: io.netty.handler.codec.EncoderException: Failed to encode packet 'serverbound/minecraft:container_click'

but sometimes it works (about 1 out of 5 times)

### Crash report (~/logs/latest.log)

[latest.log](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/33591109/latest.log)

[comment by SuperMartijn642 (owner)]
> ### Mod Loader
> Forge

From the log it seems you are using NeoForge, not Forge.

The issue seemed to occur when voiding items when special data components like enchantments and affected Minecraft 1.20.5 - 1.21.5.
I should be fixed now in Trash Cans version 1.1.2 for Minecraft 1.20.5 - 1.21.5.
Thank you for reporting the issue.
